Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1989
ACT IV OF 1989
SINDH LEPERS
(REPEAL) ACT, 1989
An Act to repeal
the Sindh Lepers Act, 1947
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 4th May, 1989]
No.PAS/Legis-B-I/89, dated
4-5-1989.--The Sindh Lepers (Repeal) Bill, 1989 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 16th March, 1989 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 18th April, 1989 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Lepers (Repeal) Act,
1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Repeal

No.PAS/Legis-B-I/89, dated
4-5-1989.--The Sindh Lepers (Repeal) Bill, 1989 having been passed by the Provincial

2. Repeal.--The Sindh
Lepers Act, 1947 is hereby repealed.
